parameters.name: MACAddress
parameters.description: The MAC address of the Non-AP STA.

parameters.name: SignalStrength
parameters.description: An indicator of radio signal strength (RCPI) of the uplink from the Non-AP STA - measured in {{units}}. RCPI is encoded per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-176}}, and described in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 10.3.2}}. Reserved: 221 - 255.

parameters.name: OperatingClass
parameters.description: Operating class on which this unassociated STA was last detected, per {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}}.

parameters.name: Channel
parameters.description: Channel on which this unassociated STA was last detected.

object.description: Each instance represents a station (STA) that has been discovered by the Radio but is not associated to any of the BSS operating on the Radio.
